## Key Patterns and Gotchas

- Simulation runs for hardcoded 100 cycles (cpu.cpp:638 programEnd()) — no proper halt detection
- Pipeline forwarding is toggled by constructor bool `fw_enable`; when disabled, stalls are inserted but logic is incomplete (TODO at cpu.cpp:480)
- ANEMMemMappedPeripheral base class methods are non-virtual — MAC uses `using` declaration to shadow, not override
- Missing `break` in switch at cpu.cpp:286 — M1 opcode case falls through to default
- BHLEQ branch flag is set in decode but never checked in fetch for jump resolution
- regPC case in writeback (cpu.cpp:567) computes `regval` but never writes it to the register bank
- Build: plain Makefile, `make sim` produces the binary, no install/test targets
